subject: SIG questionnaire follow-up — Acme Health: network diagram & runbook delivery
messages:
From: Laura Chen <lchen@acmehealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: security@acmehealth.com
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: SIG questionnaire - request for network diagram + runbooks

Hi Mina,

Thanks for taking our SIG intake. We reviewed the draft answers your team provided and have a couple of follow-ups before we can close our due diligence:

- A high-level network diagram showing egress points, load balancers, and any peering/VPC connections to third-party clouds.
- The incident response runbook (high-level and the ops-runbook we can provide under NDA) — we need screenshots or a short video of the runbook steps where applicable.
- Access control policy (who can access production keys, KMS usage notes).
- A few example audit logs or a note on retention (if you can provide a redacted sample or Drive link).

Our internal deadline to complete the SIG evidence binder is Tue, 26 Jan. Can you share a Drive folder with these artifacts, or let us know if any items require an NDA/procurement step? We can accept redacted screenshots where needed.

I've attached the latest SIG spreadsheet your team submitted (SIG_questionnaire_v2.xlsx).

Appreciate it — happy to hop on a quick call if that's easier.

Best,
Laura Chen
Security Program Manager
Acme Health
laura.chen@acmehealth.com

Attachment: SIG_questionnaire_v2.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Laura — thanks for the clear list and the XLS. We'll assemble a package.

Quick notes:
- We can share a Drive folder with redacted diagrams and runbooks by next week (target Thu 2026-01-21).
- Some audit/log exports require a data request; I will flag what we can share as redacted examples vs. what requires a formal evidence request.
- No additional NDA needed for the redacted artifacts; if you need unredacted items we can route via our SOC/compliance process.

Cc'ing Grace (SE) to coordinate the artifacts and Jonas for oversight.

Would you prefer a single zipped evidence bundle or an organized Drive folder with subfolders by control area?

Thanks — Mina
Mina Haddad
